eligibility.quote: This issue happens when a single node subscribes to a topic multiple times and each subscriber has a different message type.
eligibility.reason: E1/E4: a five-step rviz reproducer and RCLError are provided. E2: rviz requests differently typed subscriptions through the separately released Cyclone RMW; the refusal depends on the requested topic/type combinations, not an arbitrary correct peer. It is not a mere remap: the backend rejects the requested same-name multi-type interface composition. E3: PAIR at the rviz-to-RMW library API. Stop at 6.

failed_conditions.quote: This issue happens when a single node subscribes to a topic multiple times and each subscriber has a different message type.
failed_conditions.reason: Agree nominal_type_mismatch and the /test subscription API with PoseStamped and Marker. The reproduced Pose and Marker displays request different nominal message types on the same topic. This is a local API/topic-creation refusal, not proof that a wrong-typed publisher was connected.

resolution.quote: Given the age of this, and that we think there was a fix, I'm going to go ahead and close it out.
resolution.reason: Agree recommended: the maintainer recommends the Cyclone/#96/#114 changes, but the reporter tests only older binaries and still sees the crash. Related ros1_bridge success involves same-message C/C++ mappings, not this rviz Pose/Marker composition. Closure does not demonstrate the proposed resolved pair working.

notes: Read #111 and all comments, #72, #96, #114, Cyclone #382, and the rviz 7.0.4 Pose/Marker display declarations. The library API restriction explains eligibility even though both subscription requests originate in one application.
